feedback.finish: The ancient Egyptians were one of the earliest human civilisations, beginning 7,000 years ago in North-East Africa.

trainers.instruction: Find and select modern-day Egypt on the map.

feedback.correct: Egypt still exists today in the same area as it did thousands of years ago. It is located by the Mediterranean Sea in the north of Africa.

atoms.b: The first people ((++settled sneezed)) in Egypt in around 5000 BC. They lived in the desert, ((++hunting hiding)) and herding animals.
Over time, they settled on the banks of the River Nile because the river provided fresh ((++water milk)).
By the year ((++3500_BC AD_2012)), people were already living in large settlements.

instruction.text: Before ancient Egypt became one kingdom, it was divided into two parts. Look at the map and answer the questions.

atoms.a: Which part was closer to the Mediterranean Sea?

feedback.end: Access to the Mediterranean Sea allowed ancient Egypt to trade with other civilisations.
Upper Egypt was “upper” because it had a higher elevation.

atoms.a: In which part was the city of Memphis?

feedback.end: Once Egypt was unified as one kingdom, the city of Memphis was founded as its new capital.
